   128→func writeChunk(w http.ResponseWriter, c chunk) {

   141→	} else {

   143→	}

   147→func flushBuffer(w http.ResponseWriter, buffer []chunk) {

   169→	if err != nil {

   310→				writeChunkBuffered(w, chunk{Type: "error", Error: err.Error()}, &buffer, isCloudfFront)
   311→				if isCloudfFront {
   312→					flushBuffer(w, buffer)
   313→				}
   314→				return
   315→			}
   316→
   317→			messages = append(messages, anthropicMessage{
   318→				Role:    "assistant",
   319→				Content: resp.Content,
   320→			})
   321→
   322→			var toolUses []contentBlock
   323→			for _, block := range resp.Content {
   324→				switch block.Type {
   325→				case "text":
   326→					// Stream each text block as it arrives (or buffer if CloudFront)
   327→					writeChunkBuffered(w, chunk{Type: "text", Text: block.Text}, &buffer, isCloudfFront)
   328→				case "tool_use":
   329→					toolUses = append(toolUses, block)
   330→				}
   331→			}
   332→
   333→			if resp.StopReason == "end_turn" || len(toolUses) == 0 {
   334→				break
   335→			}
   336→
   337→			// ── Execute tool calls via MCP ─────────────────────────────────
   338→			var toolResults []contentBlock
   339→			for _, tu := range toolUses {
   340→				var args map[string]any
   341→				_ = json.Unmarshal(tu.Input, &args)
   342→
   343→				callReq := mcp.CallToolRequest{}
   344→				callReq.Params.Name = tu.Name
   345→				callReq.Params.Arguments = args
   346→
   347→				var resultText string
   348→				toolResult, err := mc.CallTool(ctx, callReq)
   349→				if err != nil {
   350→					resultText = fmt.Sprintf("tool error: %v", err)
   351→				} else {
   352→					for _, c := range toolResult.Content {
   353→						if tc, ok := c.(mcp.TextContent); ok {
   354→							resultText += tc.Text
   355→						}
   356→					}
   357→				}
   358→
   359→				toolResults = append(toolResults, contentBlock{
   360→					Type:      "tool_result",
   361→					ToolUseID: tu.ID,
   362→					Content:   resultText,
   363→				})
   364→			}
   365→
   366→			messages = append(messages, anthropicMessage{
   367→				Role:    "user",
   368→				Content: toolResults,
   369→			})
   370→		}
   371→
   372→		// Send final "done" chunk
   373→		writeChunkBuffered(w, chunk{Type: "done"}, &buffer, isCloudfFront)
   374→
   375→		// For CloudFront requests, flush all buffered chunks at once
   376→		if isCloudfFront {
   377→			flushBuffer(w, buffer)

    91→// gzipWrap wraps a handler to apply gzip compression when client supports it.
    92→func (s *Server) gzipWrap(next http.HandlerFunc) http.HandlerFunc {
    93→	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
    94→		if !strings.Contains(r.Header.Get("Accept-Encoding"), "gzip") {
    95→			next(w, r)
    96→			return
    97→		}
    98→		w.Header().Set("Content-Encoding", "gzip")
    99→		gz := gzip.NewWriter(w)
   100→		defer gz.Close()
   101→		grw := &gzipResponseWriter{ResponseWriter: w, Writer: gz}
   102→		next(grw, r)
   103→	}
   104→}
   105→
   106→type gzipResponseWriter struct {
   107→	http.ResponseWriter
   108→	io.Writer
   109→	written bool
   110→}
   111→
   112→func (g *gzipResponseWriter) Write(b []byte) (int, error) {
   113→	if !g.written {
   114→		g.ResponseWriter.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
   115→		g.written = true
   116→	}
   117→	return g.Writer.Write(b)
   118→}

   164→// resolveCLIColorTheme inspects the provided writer to decide whether colourful output is
   165→// appropriate. We only enable ANSI sequences when stdout points to a terminal and the
   166→// operator has not explicitly disabled colour via NO_COLOR, aligning with the "don't
   167→// fight the tool" proverb by respecting common shell conventions.
   168→func resolveCLIColorTheme(out io.Writer) cliColorTheme {
   169→	theme := cliColorTheme{}
   170→	file, ok := out.(*os.File)
   171→	if !ok {
   172→		return theme
   173→	}
   174→	if os.Getenv("NO_COLOR") != "" {
   175→		return theme
   176→	}
   177→	info, err := file.Stat()
   178→	if err != nil {
   179→		return theme
   180→	}
   181→	if (info.Mode() & os.ModeCharDevice) == 0 {
   182→		return theme
   183→	}
   184→
   185→	theme.Enabled = true
   186→	// We switch to a punchier palette that keeps contrast on both dark and light
   187→	// backgrounds without feeling gaudy. Section headings lean on a deep ocean blue,
   188→	// flags use a vibrant amber, usage strings stay in neutral charcoal, and defaults
   189→	// adopt a rich forest green. The tones remain saturated enough to pop on light
   190→	// themes while still carrying enough depth for dark terminals.
   191→	theme.Section = "\033[38;5;25m"
   192→	theme.Flag = "\033[38;5;208m"
   193→	theme.Usage = "\033[38;5;240m"
   194→	theme.Default = "\033[38;5;34m"
   195→	theme.Reset = "\033[0m"
   196→	return theme
   197→}

# Testing Guide

## Unit & Integration Tests

Tests use an in-memory SQLite database — no running server needed.

### Run all tests

```bash
go test ./pkg/... -timeout 120s
```

### Run a specific package

```bash
go test ./pkg/api/...   -v    # API endpoints
go test ./pkg/auth/...  -v    # Auth endpoints (slow: ~3s due to bcrypt)
go test ./pkg/web/...   -v    # Web/spectrum/QR handlers
```

### Run a single test

```bash
go test ./pkg/api/...  -run TestHandleShorten -v
go test ./pkg/auth/... -run TestLoginHandler  -v
```

### Expected output

```
ok  safecast-new-map/pkg/api              0.1s
ok  safecast-new-map/pkg/auth             2.9s   ← slow due to bcrypt cost 12
ok  safecast-new-map/pkg/countryresolver  0.7s
ok  safecast-new-map/pkg/safecast-realtime 0.0s
ok  safecast-new-map/pkg/web              0.5s
```

---

## Smoke Tests (end-to-end against a running server)

Requires `curl`. Tests all HTTP endpoints by making real requests.

### Prerequisites

Start the server locally (see `local-server-config.sh` for credentials):

```bash
./safecast-new-map -db-type pgx -db-conn "postgres://..." -allow-registration -admin-password test123
```

### Run smoke tests

```bash
# Local server (default)
./test/smoke_test.sh

# Custom URL and admin password
./test/smoke_test.sh http://localhost:8765 test123

# Production (read-only — registration creates a test user each run)
./test/smoke_test.sh https://simplemap.safecast.org your_admin_pw

# Also test the MCP server REST endpoints
MCP_BASE=http://localhost:3333 ./test/smoke_test.sh http://localhost:8765 test123
```

### What is tested

| Category | Endpoints |
|---|---|
| Pages | `GET /`, `/home` |
| Utilities | `/qrpng`, `/licenses/mit`, `/licenses/cc0`, `/api/docs` |
| API data | `/api`, `/api/tracks`, `/api/countries`, `/api/latest` |
| Shorten | `POST /api/shorten` (preview + bad requests) |
| Spectrum | `/api/markers/spectra`, `/api/track-info/{id}` |
| Markers | `/get_markers` |
| Auth | register, login, logout, profile, forgot-password |
| Admin | `/api/admin/uploads`, `/api/admin/tracks`, `/api/admin/users` |
| MCP REST | `/api/radiation`, `/api/stats` (if `MCP_BASE` set) |

### Notes

- Each smoke test run registers a new user with a timestamped email to avoid conflicts.
- Admin endpoints are tested with `?password=ADMIN_PW` query auth.
- The script exits with code `1` if any test fails.

---

## Coverage Report

```bash
go test ./pkg/... -coverprofile=coverage.out -timeout 120s
go tool cover -html=coverage.out -o coverage.html
open coverage.html
```
